invariants.expression: (name == null && result == -1) || (name != null && result == x + name.length())
invariants.rationale: Describes exactly how 'result' is determined by the state of 'name'.
If 'name' is not null, result is x + length >= x; otherwise, result could be -1 < x only if x > -1.
If name is null, result must be -1.
If name is non-null, result is always computed as x + name.length().
Result is at least -1 for any input.
